new_result.statement: After conditioning original coordinates H and whitening the surviving selected rank-three frame, if the spectral remainder compression is block diagonal up to operator perturbation E with parameters eta, mu, tau satisfying rho=alpha(1-eta)-tau>0 and (sqrt(mu/alpha)+sqrt(6)tau/rho)^2<=1/2, alpha=(1-sqrt(3mu))/2, then ||p_Q||inf<=9sqrt(3e)/(2rho) and the density is continuous C0.
new_result.explicit_family: n=256 Hadamard selected frame, Lambda=diag(1,1,-1), C=(1/40)(I-RR^T), gives full-rank dense remainder and ||p_Q||inf<(720/61)sqrt(3e)<34.
